verdicts.title: Rejoinder to the discussants of the two JASA articles `Frequentist Model Averaging' and `The Focused Information Criterion', by Nils Lid Hjort and Gerda Claeskens
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We are honoured to have our work read and discussed at such a thorough level by several experts. Words of appreciation and encouragement are gratefully received, while the many supplementary comments, thoughtful reminders, new perspectives and additional themes raised are warmly welcomed and deeply appreciated. Our thanks go also to JASA Editor Francisco Samaniego and his editorial helpers for organising this discussion.
  Space does not allow us answering all of the many worthwhile points raise

verdicts.title: A simple proof of the discreteness of Dirichlet processes
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: That Dirichlet processes are discrete with probability 1 is demonstrated once more. And yes, these two pages spent fifty years in Norwegian.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the discreteness of Dirichlet processes in probability theory ('Dirichlet processes are discrete with probability 1'), which has no interaction with Tseitin formulas, local induction degree, or resolution proof width.
